products.name: Laptop Pro 15
products.description: 15 inch laptop with 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD, and all-day battery. Suited to development, design, and business workloads.

products.name: Laptop Air 13
products.description: Lightweight 13 inch laptop with 8GB RAM and 256GB SSD. Built for travel and everyday productivity.

products.name: Wireless Mouse
products.description: Ergonomic 2.4GHz wireless mouse with adjustable DPI and six month battery life. Works with the USB-C Hub receiver port.

products.name: USB-C Hub
products.description: 7 in 1 USB-C hub: HDMI 4K, two USB-A, SD card reader, 100W passthrough charging. Compatible with Laptop Pro 15 and Laptop Air 13.

products.name: Noise Cancelling Headphones
products.description: Over-ear headphones with active noise cancellation, 30 hour battery, and multipoint Bluetooth pairing.

products.name: Mechanical Keyboard
products.description: Tenkeyless mechanical keyboard with hot-swappable switches and white backlight. Pairs well with the Wireless Mouse.

products.name: 4K Monitor 27
products.description: 27 inch 4K IPS monitor with USB-C input and 65W laptop charging over a single cable.

products.name: 1080p Webcam
products.description: Full HD webcam with autofocus, dual microphones, and a privacy shutter.

products.name: Portable SSD 1TB
products.description: Pocket-size 1TB SSD with USB-C, 1050MB/s reads, and hardware encryption.

products.name: Bluetooth Speaker
products.description: Compact waterproof speaker with 12 hour battery and stereo pairing.

products.name: Smartwatch S2
products.description: Fitness smartwatch with GPS, heart rate tracking, and 7 day battery.

products.name: Laptop Stand
products.description: Aluminium laptop stand with adjustable height and cable routing. Fits both laptop models.

products.name: 65W GaN Charger
products.description: Compact 65W USB-C charger that powers both laptop models and fast-charges phones.

faqs.name: Returns policy
faqs.description: Items can be returned within 30 days of delivery in original condition. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days of the return arriving.

faqs.name: Shipping times
faqs.description: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Orders over 50.00 ship free. Express delivery in 2 business days is available at checkout.

faqs.name: Warranty
faqs.description: All electronics carry a 12 month manufacturer warranty. Laptops can be extended to 36 months with a protection plan.

faqs.name: Payment methods
faqs.description: We accept major credit and debit cards, PayPal, and store gift cards. Payment is charged when the order ships.
